TestDriver writes and runs end-to-end tests for web apps, desktop apps, and browser extensions. Each test describes what a user sees and does in plain language. It runs on a real machine in the cloud.

Choose where you want to start:

<CardGroup cols={1}>
  <Card title="Add to GitHub" icon="github" href="/quickstart-github" arrow horizontal>
    An AI code reviewer that tests every pull request in a real sandbox.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Add Claude Connector" icon="terminal" href="/quickstart-claude" arrow horizontal>
    Install the connector to write and run tests from Claude Code.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Connect via MCP" icon="plug" href="/mcp-setup" arrow horizontal>
    Add one URL to any MCP client, such as Claude or ChatGPT.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Set up a project" icon="wrench" href="/quickstart-manual" arrow horizontal>
    Write and run Vitest tests in your own repository.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

Not sure? Start with GitHub. Your next pull request gets a review without any setup.

Set up a project when you want to write and run tests yourself.

<Tip>
  Questions along the way? Ask in the [TestDriver Discord](https://discord.com/invite/cWDFW8DzPm).
